name: Where Is the Unseen Razor?
description: Select one of your characters. The first time they are switched in: If their Character Level is lower than the opposing active character, then Character Level +1 for the Whole Match. If their HP is lower, then Max HP +6 for the Whole Match. If their ATK is lower, then ATK +1 for the Whole Match.
